core_obligations: Semiclassical propagation alone produces an interfering collection of local Lagrangian branches, not a Gaussian law. The authors prove generic rational independence of branch phases, identify pointwise local distributions and combine negatively curved dynamics with a many-branch limit to obtain the stated Gaussian field, in the original sequential h-to-zero then large-time order.
